title: FFmpeg lenscorrection baseline MD5 verifier
purpose: Provides a standalone script to test the documented claim that k1=0:k2=0 produces no change relative to the source. Compares stream MD5 of the unfiltered input against the k1=0:k2=0 output. A mismatch indicates codec resampling or filter-chain side-effects before any trial values are tried. Source only; not executed. Companion to artifact 3c104b4f-646d-4218-b809-c63165c17355.
